labs_page.heading: Labs, Stations & Instruments
labs_page.intro: From clean benches in Oslo to autonomous observatories at the edge of the sea — the places where samples are taken, the instruments we share, and the measurements that never stop.

lab_items.name: Marine Biogeochemistry Lab
lab_items.image_alt: Benches and analytical equipment in the marine biogeochemistry lab
lab_items.image_caption: The main wet lab at the Marine Sciences Building.
lab_items.intro: Wet chemistry, sediment processing and nutrient analysis under one roof, with a dedicated clean bench for trace metals.

lab_items.name: Soil & Rhizosphere Laboratory
lab_items.image_alt: Soil cores laid out for processing
lab_items.intro: Cold storage and sample preparation for soil cores, root material and long-term archive material.

lab_items.name: Station Nord-03 Coastal Observatory

images.image_caption: The observatory platform at low tide.

lab_items.image_alt: Coastal observatory platform in the Oslofjord
lab_items.intro: A year-round coastal node measuring temperature, salinity, turbidity and dissolved oxygen every fifteen minutes.

lab_items.name: Storglommen Alpine Station
lab_items.image_alt: Alpine field station below a glacier
lab_items.image_caption: The station at 1,410 metres, late season.
lab_items.intro: Snowpack, soil-temperature and carbon-flux measurements from an off-grid site that runs through the polar winter.

lab_items.name: ICP-MS Suite
lab_items.image_alt: ICP-MS instrument in a clean laboratory
lab_items.intro: Trace-element analysis for water, sediment and tissue samples, booked through the shared instrument calendar.

lab_items.name: Water-Quality Field Kit
lab_items.image_caption: The shared field kit, ready for deployment.
lab_items.intro: Portable meters, sample bottles and calibration standards for day trips and partner-led monitoring.

lab_items.name: Atmospheric Particulate Laboratory
lab_items.image_alt: Aerosol sampling and filter preparation equipment
lab_items.image_caption: Filter handling and gravimetric analysis for the aerosol programme.
lab_items.intro: A filtered-air bench for PM2.5 and PM10 sample handling, gravimetry and isotopic preparation, with a dedicated balance room next door.

lab_items.name: Environmental Sensor Development Lab
lab_items.image_caption: Prototype boards and calibration rigs for the sensor programme.
lab_items.intro: Electronics benches, a humidity-controlled assembly corner and a calibration tank for turbidity, conductivity and nitrate sensors.

lab_items.name: Sundarbans Nursery & Estuary Station
lab_items.image_alt: Mangrove nursery beds beside an estuary channel
lab_items.image_caption: Community nursery beds at the Sundarbans partner site.
lab_items.intro: A community-run nursery and estuarine sampling base supporting the restoration pilot, with monthly sediment-trap and porewater sampling.

lab_items.name: Automated DNA Sequencer
lab_items.image_caption: The shared benchtop sequencer used for microbial community work.
lab_items.intro: A shared benchtop sequencer for amplicon and metagenomic libraries from soil, sediment and water filters, booked through the instrument calendar.
